title: Flaky real_web_workspace scenarios: function timeout and panel-render assertion fail intermittently in CI

comments.author: home
comments.text: Seen 2026-10-20 on PR 622 (spec-only change, so unrelated): the conversation CI job failed two scenarios in features/real_web_workspace.feature, one with a function timeout and one with a panel-render assertion; rerunning the failed job passed. Also seen locally on 2026-10-19 by the Board-panel worker: one real_web_workspace scenario fails on a Mac whose OS is in dark mode because the scenario reads the OS color scheme. Make the scenarios deterministic (fixed color scheme in the harness, no wall-clock dependence) and find the timeout's cause.
